what_you_believe_happened: Signed in, found Record expense on Home, opened the Site expense form (project already Kapoor Villa (Audit), Paid through already 'I paid for this myself'). Entered description 'Binding wire' and amount 1850. Vendor had to be changed from 'Choose a project vendor' to 'No vendor', which revealed a required 'Who was paid?' field. I was not given a payee name and was told not to invent data, so I could not submit; I cancelled. Nothing was sent for approval.
unnecessary_steps: Vendor must be chosen even for a cash purchase from an unknown shop
Amount field is hidden below the fold of the modal; need to scroll inside it
confusing_terminology: Vendor vs 'Who was paid?' -> two fields asking nearly the same thing
Paid through -> unclear options at a glance
Send for approval -> unclear it is the reimbursement request
missing_feedback: Vendor required but not marked required
Who was paid? required but not marked required
No hint the form says reimbursement will follow
unexpected_behaviour: Clicking an option in the open Vendor dropdown with the mouse did not select it; keyboard worked
Choosing 'No vendor' revealed a new required field, shifting the layout
errors_encountered: Please select an item in the list.
visual_issues: Amount field is cut off at the bottom of the modal; the inline rupee echo and approval note get clipped under the footer
Browser-native validation bubbles overlap field labels
accessibility_issues: Required fields are not indicated visually or by label
observations: Record expense is easy to find on Home and the defaults (project, paid myself) are good. The form then blocks on a payee that a person buying wire in cash may not know, with no option such as 'Unknown / cash'. Stopped honestly rather than inventing a payee name.

rating_justifications.ease_of_use: Could not complete: required payee not provided by the task and no 'unknown' option.
rating_justifications.workflow_efficiency: Validation errors appeared one at a time, each needing a retry.
rating_justifications.system_feedback: Required fields not marked; errors only appeared after pressing Send, one at a time.
rating_justifications.error_prevention: Required fields not flagged up front; a hidden field appears after a dropdown choice.
rating_justifications.accessibility: Required state not indicated; dropdown mouse selection failed; amount clipped.
